items.title: Dalton Richards Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: Steve Deville was he running at the end?

ctx.x: We went to the Mardi Gras line twice. I've been to the Mardi Gras line twice. Steve Deville was he running at the end? Yeah.
And uh... There's a girls show now, but I remember they had music there.
